transcript.content: Hi, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess what brought me in is that I just... I haven't been feeling like myself lately. The things I usually enjoy, like going on photography walks or mentoring the kids in my neighborhood, they just feel really flat and heavy now. Even stuff I usually take pride in at work, like keeping a perfectly clean calendar, I just can't seem to muster the energy for it. I've just stopped initiating any of it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?

I'm not really sure. I mean... I don't know if I'd call it depressed. I'm not sitting around crying or feeling super sad or anything like that. It's just... I guess I just feel empty. Like I was saying, it's more of just that heavy feeling where I don't have the energy to care about much right now.
Did this start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

Yeah, I suppose it did. It's been... well, this has been going on for about a year and three months now. It started right after a family member's health and behavior started changing. I had to step in and take on a lot more of the coordination for them, just making sure everything was being handled. So, yeah, that was definitely a major change, and that's about when I started feeling this way.
Have you been feeling this way most days for at least two years?

No, not two years. Um... like I mentioned a second ago, it's really only been about a year and three months. Before that whole situation with my family member started, I was doing fine. So, no, definitely not two years.
During this past year, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless most days?

Well, like I mentioned earlier, I wouldn't really use the words depressed or hopeless. It's not really like that. It's just that heavy, empty feeling I was talking about. I guess I do feel that way most days, but I'm not sitting around feeling sad or hopeless about things. Just kind of drained.
Because of this heavy, empty feeling, have you been having trouble functioning in your daily life?

Well, my work has stayed intact overall. I haven't lost my job or anything. But... I have missed a few calendar details here and there, which really isn't like me. I've had to start double-checking tasks that used to be completely automatic. 

And outside of work, yeah, I guess it has affected things. I've pulled back from my photography outings and the mentoring I usually do. I just don't feel as present or reliable right now, so it's easier to just step away from it.
During this time, have you been feeling down or sad most days?

Like I mentioned a minute ago, no, I wouldn't really say I feel sad or down. It's... it's just that heavy, empty feeling I was talking about. I'm not really walking around feeling sad about things, just drained.
Even if you wouldn’t call it sadness, have you been feeling depressed most days?

I know we keep circling back to these words, but... no, I really wouldn't call it being depressed, either. It's exactly like I've been saying—it's just an empty, drained feeling. I don't feel that misery or darkness that people usually mean when they say they're depressed. I'm just kind of running on empty most days.
Even if you don’t think of it as sadness, have you been feeling emotionally low most days?

I wouldn't really call it 'low' either. I mean... I get why you keep asking, but no. It's not an emotional dip or feeling down. It really is just that emptiness I mentioned. Like the tank is just empty. There's no real emotion to it at all, low or otherwise.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, actually, that's what made me come in. The things that usually make me feel like myself... like going on photography walks, mentoring the kids, or even just keeping a really clean calendar... they all just started feeling flat and heavy. I just stopped initiating them. I don't really have the drive to do any of it right now.
Along with feeling empty and drained, have you been feeling anxious or on edge?
No, not really. I don't feel anxious or on edge at all. Like I said, it's more of an empty feeling. I'm just kind of... there. I don't have that nervous energy or anything like that.
Have you had any changes in your sleep?

Yeah, there have been some changes there. Um... there have been nights lately where I only sleep maybe two or three hours. I'll wake up way before dawn, and instead of feeling tired, I actually feel completely ready to go. I'll just get up and start answering work emails or updating appointment lists. It's a bit strange, but I just don't feel tired on those nights.
On those nights when you sleep only two or three hours and still feel ready to go, do you become more active than usual?

Yeah, I do. During those stretches, I just start doing a lot. I'll be rebuilding work templates, making care plans, emailing relatives, reorganizing files... usually all at once. It just feels like... well, like sitting still would mean I'm dropping the ball somewhere. So I just stay up and keep busy.
During those times when you sleep only a few hours and stay very busy, do you feel unusually upbeat or irritable?

It's kind of a mix of both. I have these stretches where I feel really upbeat, like everything is just clicking and I'm totally on top of it all. But then... if something small happens, like someone reschedules a meeting at the last minute or moves something on my desk, I can get really sharp with people. It actually surprises me how irritable I get over something so minor.
During those energized periods, do you feel more confident or capable than usual?

Yeah, I really do. Um... I'll feel like I'm the only one who can actually straighten out the doctors, the families, and just the whole office. I get to this point where I start believing that my system is simply better than anyone else's judgment. It just seems obvious to me during those times that I know exactly how things should be run and everyone else is just kind of in the way.
When those energized periods happen, do they usually last at least 4 days in a row?

I'm not really sure about the exact number of days, to be honest. I haven't really kept track of it like that. I know it lasts for a stretch, but... I couldn't tell you if it's four days in a row or not. I just don't really count the days when I'm in the middle of it.
During those energized periods, have you ever had to be hospitalized because of them?

No, I haven't. Um, I've never had to go to the hospital or anything like that because of it. I just get really intense at work and kind of take over, but it's never gotten to a point where I needed to be admitted anywhere.
During those energized periods, have you ever had experiences like hearing or seeing things other people didn’t, or strongly believing something others said wasn’t true?

Yeah, actually. Um... during those high-energy stretches, that feeling I get where I'm certain that phone messages or calendar problems mean something special... it gets a lot stronger. And sometimes, when I'm running on very little sleep during those periods, I would hear these short comments. Just quick things, but nobody else around seemed to hear them.
Have you ever heard those comments or had those special-meaning beliefs when you were not in one of those high-energy periods?

Yeah, I have. Um... there have been times, like whole weeks where I felt completely calm. I wasn't revved up, I was sleeping normally, just going about my regular day. But even during those quiet times, for more than a couple of weeks, I would still hear my name being called. Or... I'd still have that strong feeling, like I was totally convinced that just ordinary comments from my boss or coworkers were actually coded tests for me. So, yeah, it happens even when I'm not in one of those high-energy phases.
